about.bio_1: I am a frontend developer and UI/UX enthusiast based in Frankfurt. My journey into tech started with a fascination for how things work — and evolved into a passion for building digital experiences that feel alive.
about.bio_2: With over 5 years of experience, I specialize in crafting performant web applications using modern .NET and JavaScript ecosystems.

contact.testimonial_1_text: Mahbod is one of the most talented developers I have worked with. His attention to detail and ability to translate complex requirements into elegant solutions is exceptional.
contact.testimonial_2_text: Working with Mahbod was a game-changer for our team. He consistently delivered pixel-perfect implementations ahead of schedule.
contact.testimonial_3_text: Mahbod brings a rare combination of technical excellence and creative vision. He doesn't just write code — he crafts experiences.
